item.tib: bon theg pa chen po'i sa lam
item.coloph: bon theg pa chen po'i sa dang lam gyi rim pa/ legs bshad dri med gsung gi 'od zer zhes bya ba/ snyigs ma'i dus bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa lnga brgya pa phrag bdun pa dang nye ba na/ nyi 'og gi rgyal khams kha ba can gyi ljongs gangs ri'i khrod du/ sngon gyi 'phrin las dang smon lam bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i stobs kyis/ 'gro ba'i dpal mgon du sku 'khrungs te/ rang gzhan gyi sde snod rab 'jam ('byams) la rtogs pa'i snang ba brnyes pa/ rje mkhas btsun rtogs ldan gyi bla ma mang du bsten cing / sngags sems mtshan nyid lung rigs man ngag mang du mthong zhing thos pas/ shes rab kyi snang ba cung zad thob pa'i rwa btsun rig 'dzin rgyal mtshan gyis/ ya ngal jo sras kyi zhabs thog tu tshig don rnam pa shin tu gsal bar sbyar ba rdzogs so//
